job.job_title: Lead AI ML Engineer Agentic AI LangGraph
job.job_description:
Lead AI/ML Engineer Agentic AI / LangGraph


Experience: 6 to 8 Years
Leadership Experience: Minimum 3 Years as Lead / Team Handling
Location: Noida
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)
Employment Type: Full-Time


Job Summary


We are looking for a Lead AI/ML Engineer with 6 to 8 years of overall experience, including at least 3 years of experience leading/mentoring AI/ML engineering teams.
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical leader with strong expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLM applications and LangGraph, capable of designing, developing and deploying production-grade AI solutions while leading a team of engineers.
The candidate will be responsible for driving technical direction, mentoring engineers, reviewing architecture/code, solving complex AI engineering problems and collaborating with senior stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


Lead the design and development of production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions.
Build and architect multi-agent systems and intelligent workflows using LangGraph.
Develop LLM-powered applications involving RAG, tool/function calling, memory, planning, reasoning and workflow orchestration.
Design agent workflows with state management, conditional routing, retries, human-in-the-loop and error handling.
Work with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication for enterprise AI integrations.
Design and implement scalable DAG/workflow-based orchestration for AI agents and business processes.
Work with LiteLLM or similar LLM abstraction/model-routing frameworks for multi-model and multi-provider integrations.
Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI.
Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, APIs and microservices.
Design and implement RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search and retrieval optimization.
Own AI/ML modules throughout the complete lifecycle from architecture and development to deployment, monitoring and production support.
Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews and code reviews.
Lead, mentor and manage a team of AI/ML engineers, ensuring engineering quality and timely delivery.
Guide junior and mid-level engineers on Agentic AI, LLM application development and best practices.
Collaborate with product, engineering, business and senior stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.
Establish best practices around AI security, guardrails, observability, evaluation and responsible AI.
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and drive solutions from PoC to production.



Mandatory Skills


AI / ML / GenAI


6 to 8 years of overall experience in software engineering / AI/ML.
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI and LLM applications.
Strong understanding of Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems.
Strong Python programming skills.
Experience with LLMs/foundation models such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama or equivalent.



Agentic AI & Orchestration


Strong hands-on experience with LangGraph.
Experience designing stateful agent workflows using nodes, edges, conditional routing and workflow orchestration.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Experience with A2A / Agent-to-Agent communication.
Experience with DAG-based workflow orchestration.
Hands-on experience with tool/function calling.
Experience with agent memory, planning/reasoning and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Experience with LiteLLM or equivalent model abstraction/routing frameworks.



RAG & LLM Applications


Strong experience building RAG applications.
Experience with embeddings, semantic search, hybrid search and re-ranking.
Hands-on experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Qdrant, Azure AI Search, pgvector or equivalent.
Experience with prompt engineering and structured outputs.
Understanding of RAG evaluation, LLM evaluation and observability.



Backend / Cloud


Strong experience with Python and FastAPI.
Experience developing REST APIs and microservices.
Experience integrating LLM applications with enterprise APIs, databases and business systems.
Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP.
Docker and Kubernetes experience is preferred.
Understanding of CI/CD and production deployment practices.



Leadership & Team Handling Mandatory


Minimum 3 years of experience in a Lead / Team Lead / Technical Lead / Engineering Lead capacity.
Proven experience managing or mentoring AI/ML/GenAI engineers.
Experience conducting code reviews and architecture/design reviews.
Ability to define technical standards and development best practices.
Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making capabilities.
Ability to distribute work, track delivery and support team members technically.
Experience working directly with senior stakeholders, architects, product teams and business teams.
Ability to act as a bridge between engineering teams and senior stakeholders.



Good to Have


LangChain / LlamaIndex / CrewAI / AutoGen.
AWS Bedrock / Azure AI Foundry / Vertex AI.
RAGAS / LangSmith / MLflow or other evaluation and observability frameworks.
Redis / PostgreSQL.
AI security, guardrails and responsible AI.
Knowledge Graph / GraphRAG.
Kubernetes / Helm / Terraform.
Experience with enterprise-scale AI deployments.



Core Technology Stack


Python | LangGraph | LangChain | Agentic AI | GenAI | LLMs | MCP | A2A | LiteLLM | RAG | Multi-Agent Systems | Tool Calling | Vector DB | FastAPI | REST APIs | Cloud | Docker | Kubernetes


Ideal Candidate Profile


The ideal candidate should be:
Hands-on Engineer + Technical Lead + Team Mentor
We are not looking for someone who is purely managerial or purely architecture-focused. The candidate should continue to write/review code, design AI architectures, solve technical challenges and mentor the engineering team while interacting with senior stakeholders.




NOTE - We are only looking for Immediate joiners who can join in max 15 Days


Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML, Data Science or a related technical field.
